html:
Mexico City is the capital and largest city of Mexico, built on the ruins of the Aztec capital Tenochtitlan in the Valley of Mexico, at over 2,200 metres. It has been the seat of power in the region for about 700 years.

Tenochtitlan stood on an island in Lake Texcoco, fed in part by the floating fields called chinampas. After Hernán Cortés took it in the siege of 1521, the Spanish rebuilt it as a European grid city on top of the old one. The cathedral rose beside the buried Templo Mayor.

As capital of the Viceroyalty of New Spain from 1535 it ruled lands from California to Central America and the Philippines. It had the first mint in the Americas, the first printing press in 1539, a university from 1551 and a tribunal of the Inquisition from 1571. Its silver pesos went around the world.

The Spanish drained the lakes to stop floods, and the city has been sinking into the soft lakebed ever since. It became the capital of independent Mexico in 1821. In the 1900s it grew into one of the largest cities on Earth, hosted the 1968 Olympics, and suffered the deadly earthquake of 1985.
sum: Mexico City is the capital and largest city of Mexico, built on the ruins of the Aztec capital Tenochtitlan in the Valley of Mexico, at over 2,200 metres. It has been the seat of power in the region for about 700 years.
